about: The ONE list of scored optional gates, lenses and advisories, read by scripts/build-feature-scorecard.sh. record: none, or {glob (relative to the state dir), format (result_block | text | json | tsv), field, header?, columns?, valid?}. ran / caught: {present: true} | {match: <jq regex>} | {ratio_below_one: true}; caught may be "unknown" when a catch is not attributable from the record alone. cost: none, {source: token_ledger, agent: <agent type suffix>} or {source: duration, field: <seconds field in the same record>}. not_features: optional SUPERVISOR_RESULT fields that are not features.

checks executed to a result (status pass or advisory_failures)
